svg.aria-label: Tri-Branch Fusion CNN: Oral Cancer Screening Validation accuracy: 72.02%. My capstone (BAI685): non-invasive oral cancer screening that pairs autofluorescence imaging (AFI) with edge AI. It fuses three branches (a WLI RGB CNN, an AFI grayscale CNN and a metadata MLP) and targets sub-200 ms INT8 TFLite inference on an ESP32-S3.
